Asm.Template:
LD E, A
        LD C, 2
        CALL 5

; A = val (0-255)
        LD B, A
        ; Hundreds digit
        LD C, 0
        .hloop: CP 100
    JR C, .hdone
    SUB 100
    INC C
    JR .hloop
        .hdone:
        LD B, A
        LD A, C
    OR A
    JR Z, .skip_h
        ADD A, 48
    LD E, A
    PUSH BC
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5
    POP BC
        .skip_h:
        ; Tens digit
        LD A, B
    LD C, 0
        .tloop: CP 10
    JR C, .tdone
    SUB 10
    INC C
    JR .tloop
        .tdone:
        LD B, A
        LD A, C
    ADD A, 48
    LD E, A
    PUSH BC
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5
    POP BC
        ; Units digit
        LD A, B
    ADD A, 48
    LD E, A
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5

; x in A, y in C (PFCCO: first=A, second=C)
        LD H, A         ; H = x
        LD L, C         ; L = y
        PUSH HL         ; save [x, y] on stack

        ; ESC
        LD E, 0x1B
        LD C, 2
        CALL 5
        ; [
        LD E, 91
        LD C, 2
        CALL 5

        ; y+1 as decimal
        POP HL
        PUSH HL         ; peek [x, y]
        LD A, L         ; A = y
        INC A
        LD B, A         ; save in B for _tui_print_dec
        ; inline print_dec (A = value)
        ; Hundreds
        LD C, 0
        .gh: CP 100
    JR C, .ghd
    SUB 100
    INC C
    JR .gh
        .ghd: LD B, A
    LD A, C
    OR A
    JR Z, .gsh
        ADD A, 48
    LD E, A
    PUSH BC
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5
    POP BC
        .gsh:
        ; Tens
        LD A, B
    LD C, 0
        .gt: CP 10
    JR C, .gtd
    SUB 10
    INC C
    JR .gt
        .gtd: LD B, A
    LD A, C
    ADD A, 48
    LD E, A
    PUSH BC
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5
    POP BC
        ; Units
        LD A, B
    ADD A, 48
    LD E, A
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5

        ; semicolon
        LD E, 59
        LD C, 2
        CALL 5

        ; x+1 as decimal
        POP HL          ; restore [x, y]
        LD A, H         ; A = x
        INC A
        ; inline print_dec
        LD C, 0
        .xh: CP 100
    JR C, .xhd
    SUB 100
    INC C
    JR .xh
        .xhd: LD B, A
    LD A, C
    OR A
    JR Z, .xsh
        ADD A, 48
    LD E, A
    PUSH BC
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5
    POP BC
        .xsh:
        LD A, B
    LD C, 0
        .xt: CP 10
    JR C, .xtd
    SUB 10
    INC C
    JR .xt
        .xtd: LD B, A
    LD A, C
    ADD A, 48
    LD E, A
    PUSH BC
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5
    POP BC
        LD A, B
    ADD A, 48
    LD E, A
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5

        ; H
        LD E, 72
        LD C, 2
        CALL 5

; fg in A, bg in C, bright in B
        ; Compute fg_code = 30 + fg, bg_code = 40 + bg
        ADD A, 30       ; A = 30 + fg
        LD D, A         ; D = fg_code
        LD A, C
        ADD A, 40       ; A = 40 + bg
        LD E, A         ; E = bg_code
        ; If bright != 0, add 60 to both
        LD A, B
        OR A
        JR Z, .no_bright
        LD A, D
    ADD A, 60
    LD D, A
        LD A, E
    ADD A, 60
    LD E, A
        .no_bright:
        ; Save [fg_code, bg_code] on stack
        PUSH DE

        ; ESC
        LD E, 0x1B
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5
        ; [
        LD E, 91
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5

        ; fg_code as decimal
        POP DE
        PUSH DE         ; peek
        LD A, D         ; A = fg_code
        ; inline print_dec
        LD C, 0
        .fh: CP 100
    JR C, .fhd
    SUB 100
    INC C
    JR .fh
        .fhd: LD B, A
    LD A, C
    OR A
    JR Z, .fsh
        ADD A, 48
    LD E, A
    PUSH BC
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5
    POP BC
        .fsh:
        LD A, B
    LD C, 0
        .ft: CP 10
    JR C, .ftd
    SUB 10
    INC C
    JR .ft
        .ftd: LD B, A
    LD A, C
    ADD A, 48
    LD E, A
    PUSH BC
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5
    POP BC
        LD A, B
    ADD A, 48
    LD E, A
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5

        ; semicolon
        LD E, 59
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5

        ; bg_code as decimal
        POP DE          ; restore
        LD A, E         ; A = bg_code
        ; inline print_dec
        LD C, 0
        .bh: CP 100
    JR C, .bhd
    SUB 100
    INC C
    JR .bh
        .bhd: LD B, A
    LD A, C
    OR A
    JR Z, .bsh
        ADD A, 48
    LD E, A
    PUSH BC
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5
    POP BC
        .bsh:
        LD A, B
    LD C, 0
        .bt: CP 10
    JR C, .btd
    SUB 10
    INC C
    JR .bt
        .btd: LD B, A
    LD A, C
    ADD A, 48
    LD E, A
    PUSH BC
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5
    POP BC
        LD A, B
    ADD A, 48
    LD E, A
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5

        ; m
        LD E, 109
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5

LD E, 0x1B
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5
        LD E, 91
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5
        LD E, 48
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5
        LD E, 109
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5

; ESC [ 2 J
        LD E, 0x1B
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5
        LD E, 91
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5
        LD E, 50
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5
        LD E, 74
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5
        ; ESC [ H
        LD E, 0x1B
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5
        LD E, 91
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5
        LD E, 72
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5

.loop: LD A, (HL)
    OR A
    RET Z
        LD E, A
    PUSH HL
    LD C, 2
    CALL 5
    POP HL
    INC HL
        JR .loop

; BDOS 1: blocking console input, char returned in A.
        LD C, 1
        CALL 5
        CP 27              ; ESC?
        RET NZ

        ; Try to decode VT100 escape sequence ESC [ X
        LD C, 1
        CALL 5
        CP 91              ; '['
        LD A, 27
        RET NZ

        LD C, 1
        CALL 5
        CP 65              ; 'A'
        JR Z, .up
        CP 66              ; 'B'
        JR Z, .down
        CP 67              ; 'C'
        JR Z, .right
        CP 68              ; 'D'
        JR Z, .left
        LD A, 27
        RET

        .up:
        LD A, 128
        RET
        .down:
        LD A, 129
        RET
        .left:
        LD A, 130
        RET
        .right:
        LD A, 131
        RET

; HL=buf, C=maxlen
        PUSH HL         ; save buf base
        LD (HL), C      ; buf[0] = maxlen (BDOS header)
        EX DE, HL       ; DE = buf
        LD C, 10
        CALL 5          ; BDOS 0x0A: buffered line input
        ; buf[0]=max, buf[1]=actual, buf[2..]=text
        POP HL          ; HL = buf
        INC HL
        LD A, (HL)      ; A = actual length
        INC HL          ; HL = buf+2 (source)
        PUSH AF         ; save length for return
        ; Copy buf[2..2+len] → buf[0..len] using LDIR
        LD D, H
        LD E, L
        DEC DE
        DEC DE          ; DE = buf (destination)
        LD C, A
        LD B, 0         ; BC = length
        OR A
        JR Z, .done
        LDIR
        .done:
        XOR A
        LD (DE), A      ; null-terminate buf[len]
        POP AF          ; A = actual length

; HL = str, width = C (PFCCO: ptr→HL, u8→C)
        LD B, C         ; B = remaining width (loop counter)
        LD A, C
        OR A
        RET Z           ; width == 0 → nothing to do
        .loop:
        LD A, (HL)      ; load current char
        OR A
        JR Z, .pad      ; hit null → switch to padding
        ; Print character from string
        LD E, A
        PUSH HL         ; save string pointer
        PUSH BC         ; save width counter
        LD C, 2
        CALL 5
        POP BC
        POP HL
        INC HL          ; advance string pointer
        DJNZ .loop
        RET
        .pad:
        ; Fill remaining width with spaces
        LD E, 32
        PUSH HL         ; save pointer (not advancing, but keep stack balanced)
        PUSH BC         ; save counter
        LD C, 2
        CALL 5
        POP BC
        POP HL
        DJNZ .pad
